walkthrough.title: How Does the Service Work?
walkthrough.subtitle: From one WhatsApp message to a license in your hand

steps.title: Send a WhatsApp Message
steps.description: Tell us which type of license you need
steps.detail: We reply within minutes with a clear list of requirements.
fullDetails: Your first message starts with a quick, no-obligation review of your situation and the license category you need.
We explain the available service packages, expected government steps, and likely overall timeline before you commit.

steps.title: Send Your Documents
steps.description: Share copies of your Civil ID and passport
steps.detail: We review every document and confirm it is valid before submission.
fullDetails: Send clear photos or scans securely through WhatsApp. We check names, dates, image quality, and missing pages.
If anything needs replacing or updating, we tell you exactly what is needed before the application moves forward.
clientTasks: Provide any missing item we flag

steps.title: We Open Your Traffic File
steps.description: We handle the government paperwork for you
steps.detail: We visit the traffic department on your behalf and open your file.
fullDetails: Once your documents are approved, we prepare the application and manage the traffic-department procedures included in your package.
You receive progress updates, so you always know where your documents are and what has been completed.
clientTasks: Attend only if an authority requires you
handledTasks: Follow up with the traffic department

steps.title: We Book Your Tests
steps.detail: We find the nearest available appointment and accompany you.
fullDetails: We coordinate the required theory and road-test appointments around the earliest official availability and your schedule.
Before each appointment, we confirm the location, timing, documents to bring, and the support included in your package.
clientTasks: Attend and complete the required tests

steps.title: Receive Your License
steps.description: We deliver the license to your door
steps.detail: Receive it ready to use without another unnecessary trip.
fullDetails: After the required approvals and successful tests, we complete the final issuance steps covered by your package.
We check the finished license details and arrange delivery, bringing the process to a clear and convenient close.
handledTasks: Check and deliver the finished license

items.q: How long does the process take?
items.a: The process takes between two weeks and three months, depending on the selected package and application type.

items.q: Which documents do I need to provide?
items.a: Your Civil ID, passport, university certificate, and salary certificate.

items.q: Are government fees included in the service price?
items.a: No. Government fees are paid separately.

items.q: Can I receive support in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Our team provides support in both Arabic and English.

items.q: Do you provide services for Kuwaiti citizens?
items.a: Yes. We serve both Kuwaiti citizens and expatriates.

items.q: Can I convert my foreign driving license?
items.a: Yes, provided your license was issued by an approved country.
